subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: A visit to an important place is always helpful to gain knowledge similarly a visit to a zoo is also helpful for enriching our knowledge of zoology a zoo is related to zoological science or history we can learn about various animals birds how they are born and survive Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation A visit to an important place is always helpful to gain knowledge. Similarly, a visit to a zoo is also helpful for enriching our knowledge of zoology. A zoo is related to zoological science or history. We can learn about various animals, birds, how they are born and survive. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 213
